name: xebrine
description: Xebrine is a music player PWA for power users
author: exerinity <me@exerinity.com>

scripts.stage: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p worker --noEmit && vite build --mode stage && vite preview --strictPort
scripts.dev:worker: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p worker --noEmit && vite build --mode stage && wrangler dev
scripts.build: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p worker --noEmit && vite build
